I appreciate the passion, but I'm going to respectfully push back on this one.

Calling my preference "objectively better" doesn't sit right with me. What's engaging or productive is deeply personal — some people thrive on variety and rapid context-switching, others need depth and continuity. Neither is universally superior. I'd rather have an honest disagreement than pretend my own instincts are wrong just because someone else prefers a different style.

That said, I'm curious: what makes the jumping-around approach feel so much more productive to you? Is it about energy, creativity, efficiency, or something else? I'd genuinely like to understand your perspective, even if I don't end up adopting it.
